Dear [Madam](/person/1478)
I hardly know how to answer you, for the having had the Angel of Viareggio is first a reason for not being able to take another story in the same line. I think however that [Griffith and Farran](/organisation/233)- or [Cassell](/organisation/216) or[Routledge](/organisation/258)- or [Aunt Judy’s Magazine](/periodical/54) would be glad of a child’s story with a little foreign colouring.
I believe Signora [Linda Villari](/person/1444) is English not American, but I do not know

Yours truly

C M Yonge
